description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the CohortService interface for managing cohorts in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, voiding, unvoiding, and deleting cohorts and their memberships, along with external dependencies for database access, context management, logging, and transaction handling.

classes.name: CohortServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CohortService interface providing methods to manage cohort entities and their memberships, including CRUD operations, voiding, unvoiding, and notifications.

methods.name: setCohortDAO
methods.description: Injects the CohortDAO dependency for database operations related to cohorts.

methods.name: saveCohort
methods.description: Validates and saves a Cohort object to the database, checking privileges and required fields.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort by its internal ID.

methods.name: voidCohort
methods.description: Void a cohort, though the implementation here calls saveCohort, possibly expecting modifications on the cohort object.

methods.name: getCohortByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a Cohort using its UUID.

methods.name: getCohortMembershipByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a CohortMembership using its UUID.

methods.name: addPatientToCohort
methods.description: Adds a patient to a cohort if they are not already a member, creating a new membership.

methods.name: removePatientFromCohort
methods.description: Removes a patient from a cohort by voiding their cohort memberships.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatient
methods.description: Returns a list of cohorts that contain the specified patient.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatientId
methods.description: Gets cohorts that contain a patient with the specified ID as of the current date.

methods.name: getCohorts
methods.description: Searches for cohorts matching a name fragment.

methods.name: getAllCohorts
methods.description: Retrieves all cohorts, possibly including voided ones.

methods.name: getAllCohorts (boolean includeVoided)
methods.description: Retrieves all cohorts with an option to include or exclude voided cohorts.

methods.name: getCohortByName
methods.description: Fetches a cohort by its exact name.

methods.name: purgeCohort
methods.description: Deletes a cohort from the database.

methods.name: purgeCohortMembership
methods.description: Removes a specific cohort membership from the database and updates the cohort.

methods.name: voidCohortMembership
methods.description: Marks a cohort membership as voided (logical delete).

methods.name: endCohortMembership
methods.description: Sets the end date for a cohort membership, marking its conclusion.

methods.name: notifyPatientVoided
methods.description: Updates cohort memberships to reflect a voided patient, propagating void status to memberships.

methods.name: notifyPatientUnvoided
methods.description: Reverses voided status for cohort memberships of an unvoided patient, matching original voided details.

methods.name: getCohortMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves cohort memberships for a given patient ID, date, and void status.
